name: claude-code
description: Claude Code terminal panel for Pulsar editor
author: BeanGreen247

cliPath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI executable

protectSystemFiles.description: Block file modifications in system directories (/etc, /usr, /bin, /lib, etc.) and sensitive home paths (~/.ssh, ~/.gnupg). Disable only if you explicitly need to edit system configuration.

model.description: Model to use (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7, claude-haiku-4-5). Leave blank to use the CLI default.

maxTurns.description: Maximum agentic turns per request. Lower values cap runaway loops and reduce token spend.

fontSize.description: Terminal font size in points. Set to 0 to follow the editor font size automatically.
